blockerReverification.correctionToPriorRecord: The stored blocker said 37 findings split 28 not-started-scope plus 9 G068 'no DoD items'. Re-measured at this HEAD the split is different and the prior characterisation is only partly right. The 53 scope-attributed failures are 25 'no faithful DoD item', 18 'report is missing evidence reference for concrete test file', and 10 'scenario has no traceable Test Plan row'. The 9 'no DoD items' class no longer appears at all: every one of the 9 scopes now yields DoD checkboxes (16/14/15/16/16/12/14/19/25), so the tiered-DoD extractor defect that class described was already repaired upstream by BUG-026.
blockerReverification.rootCauseOfTheLargestClass: The 25 'no faithful DoD item' findings are guard false positives, confirmed by reading guard source rather than inferred from the count. classify_match_kind already extracts trace IDs from both sides and returns 'declared' on a shared ID, but it runs only AFTER scenario_matches_dod has succeeded, so an explicit ID can never establish a match — only grade one word-overlap already found. Compounding that, the matcher receives the 'Scenario:' title while the SCN- ID lives on the preceding '###' heading, so no ID reaches the comparison at all. The guard's own 'declared=0' is the proof: it is structural, not an authoring property. Worked example: DoD item 'TP-01-04 Regression E2E evidence proves SCN-007-005 discloses the U.S. core-session remainder' names SCN-007-005 outright, and its scenario 'Four-hour U.S. stock bars require an explicit session policy' is still reported unmapped. Routed upstream as .github/bubbles-project/proposals/20260812-traceability-scenario-id-declared-mapping.md.
blockerReverification.whatIsNotAGuardDefect: The 18 missing-evidence findings are honest: they target scopes 02-09, whose status is Not Started and whose tests therefore do not exist yet. They are not false positives and are deliberately excluded from the upstream proposal. Feature 007 does not become clean by fixing the ID mapping alone.
